body:
Fixes #2840. Failure comments now name the model Claude actually ran, as reported in its own stream. When no model was reported, the comment says so instead of presenting the alias mapping as the model. Retries choose the default fallback from the reported model. The [case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2840-05f8c845bc2c/docs/case-studies/issue-2840/README.md) has the evidence and root causes.

### Reproduction

On the pre-fix commit, [`experiments/issue-2840-model-comment-repro.mjs`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2840-05f8c845bc2c/experiments/issue-2840-model-comment-repro.mjs) prints the comment from the issue. The input is the default `opus` with no `resultModelUsage`, which is every error path since #2690:

```
resolveModelId(opus) = claude-opus-5
fallback(opus) = opus-4-8
- Requested: `opus` (`claude-opus-5`)
- **Model: Claude Opus 5** (`claude-opus-5`)
```

### Root causes

1. `getModelInfoForComment` fell back to `resolveModelId(requestedModel)` and rendered it as the bold `**Model:**` line, the same line used for a verified model.
2. Since #2690, `resultModelUsage` exists only after a real success `result`. Nothing kept the model IDs that Claude reports much earlier, in `system/init` and in every assistant `message.model`. A crash, an OOM kill (exit 137) or an error therefore left no actual model.
3. `opus` mapped to `claude-opus-5`, so the fallback chain was `opus → claude-opus-5 → opus-4-8`, which skipped Opus 5. `main` moved `opus` to `claude-opus-5-5` in #2771 while this PR was open. This PR keeps that mapping, adds a catalog comment on why it must track Claude Code's alias, and no longer depends on the mapping being current.

### What changes

- **`src/observed-models.lib.mjs` (new).**
  - `claude.lib.mjs` records each model ID from `system/init` and assistant `message.model` as the stream event arrives, so the ID survives a crash or kill.
  - `<synthetic>` is ignored (#1486), and sub-agent models (`parent_tool_use_id`) are listed after main-thread models.
  - The registry is reset at the start of each Claude session.
  - It is process-wide because failure comments are posted from call sites, such as the pre-exit notifier, that never see the tool result.
  - The first sighting of each model is logged: `🤖 Model reported by Claude (system/init): claude-opus-5-5`.
- **Failure comment.**
  - `attachLogToGitHub` uses the observed IDs when there is no `resultModelUsage`, so web-capture#178 would now show `claude-opus-5-5`.
  - `getModelInfoForComment` no longer turns the requested alias into a `**Model:**` line. With no reported model, failures show `- Requested (actual model unknown — session ended before result): \`opus\` (\`claude-opus-5-5\`)`. Other cases show `... — not reported by the tool`.
- **Retries.**
  - `prepareRetryAfterError`, `maybeSwitchToFallbackModel` and `resolveConfiguredFallbackModel` take `actualModel`. Claude passes the latest main-thread model observed for the model that is still requested.
  - The default chain steps down from what ran (`claude-opus-5-5 → opus-5`). An explicit `--fallback-model` still wins, and an unknown observed model falls back to the requested model's chain.
  - When the reported model differs from the alias mapping, the switch warning adds `[actually ran <id>]`.
- The `docs/MODELS*.md` example output is updated to the current aliases. A patch changeset is included.

### Tests

`tests/issue-2840-observed-model.test.mjs` (14 cases):
- The alias table and default fallback (`opus → claude-opus-5-5 → opus-5`).
- Event extraction for init, assistant, synthetic, user, malformed and sub-agent events.
- Registry ordering and the latest model per requested model.
- Fallback selection with an observed model, an unknown one and an explicit `--fallback-model`.
- The capacity-switch warning.
- Both comment labels.
- A replay of web-capture#178: stream events, then no `result`, then `attachLogToGitHub` with a fake `gh`. The posted comment contains `claude-opus-5-5` and not `claude-opus-5`.

Local results:
- `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` and `scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh` pass.
- I ran all 616 test files under `tests/` on the merged branch. Fourteen fail identically on `main`/the pre-fix commit, and all are unrelated: playwright-mcp-prompts, activity-timeout-1510, agent-budget-stats-1526, billing-limit-detection, claude-revert-conflict, issue-1572-push-sync, issue-1600-comprehensive, issue-1600-log-fixtures, issue-1706-sub-session-size, merge-changesets-1452, opusplan-support, prompt-explore-sub-agent, solution-summary and telegram-solve-queue.
- Two more, issue-2613-regressions and issue-467-terminal-watch, failed only under 10-way parallel load. Each passes when run alone, on this branch and on `main`.

## Working session summary

I fixed issue #2840, and PR #2854 is ready for review: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/2854. All CI checks pass on the final commit (`fcbe5ec2`), it includes the latest `main`, and there was no new feedback on the issue or the PR.

**What was wrong:**
- Since #2690, the actual model is only saved when Claude reaches a successful `result`. On any error, crash or kill (such as the out-of-memory exit 137 on web-capture#178), the failure comment fell back to the bundled alias mapping. It showed that guess in the same bold `**Model:**` line used for a confirmed model.
- Nothing kept the model IDs Claude reports earlier in its stream, in `system/init` and in each assistant message.
- `opus` mapped to `claude-opus-5`, so the default fallback went from `opus` straight to `opus-4-8` and skipped Opus 5.

**What the fix does:**
- **Records the model as it streams.** A new `src/observed-models.lib.mjs` saves each model ID Claude reports as the event arrives, so it survives a crash or kill. Placeholder `<synthetic>` entries are ignored, and sub-agent models are listed after the main model.
- **Comment uses it.** When the session never reached `result`, the failure comment now names the reported model (`claude-opus-5-5` for the web-capture#178 case).
- **Honest label when unknown.** If Claude reported no model, the comment says "Requested (actual model unknown — session ended before result)" instead of presenting the alias mapping as the model.
- **Fallback follows the real model.** Retries now step down from the model that actually ran (`claude-opus-5-5` → `opus-5`). An explicit `--fallback-model` still takes priority. When the reported model differs from the alias mapping, the switch warning adds `[actually ran <id>]`.
- **Alias table.** `main` had already moved `opus` to `claude-opus-5-5` in #2771 while this PR was open. I kept that and added a catalog comment saying the mapping must track Claude Code's alias.

**Testing:**
- A script in `experiments/` reproduces the exact wrong comment from the issue on the code before the fix.
- `tests/issue-2840-observed-model.test.mjs` (14 tests, all passing) includes a replay of web-capture#178 through the real comment-posting code with a fake `gh`.
- Lint, format check and the line-limit check pass.
- I ran all 616 test files locally. 14 fail the same way on `main`, unrelated to this change. Two more, `issue-2613-regressions` and `issue-467-terminal-watch`, failed only when many tests ran in parallel; each passes when run alone, on this branch and on `main`.

The PR description and `docs/case-studies/issue-2840/README.md` have the evidence and root-cause analysis.
